name: privacy-preserving-browser-agent
description: Chrome extension: on-device redaction, then a redacted round-trip to a server model that returns page actions.
//type: Declared so Node reads the ESM layers (src/vision, src/nlp) as modules, which lets the eval harness import and test them directly. Content scripts are plain classic scripts loaded via <script>, never through Node's module loader, so this does not affect them.

scripts.lint: node --check src/background/serviceWorker.js && node --check src/popup/popup.js && node --check src/agent/protocol.js && node --check src/privacy/sanitizer.js && node --check server/index.mjs
scripts.test: npm run eval && npm run test:safety && npm run test:server
